title: A Few Landmines
description: This mod adds landmines with different explosion factors.
body:
This mod adds landmines with different explosion factors.

**Landmines:**

Craft a landmine with 1 iron ingot, 1 redstone dust, and at least 1 gunpowder.

If you craft it with 1 gunpowder, the explosion factor will be 1. If you craft it with 2 gunpowder, the explosion factor will be 2. If you craft it with 1 gunpowder, the explosion factor will be 3.

**Explosion Factors:**

A placd landmine will explode if you break it or step on it. The explosion factor determines how much it explodes. An explosion factor of 1 will give a regular explosion. And explosion factor of 2 will make the explosion a little bit stronger. An explosion factor of 3 makes the explosion the most powerful.
